title: Say It Another Way: Auditing LLMs with a User-Grounded Automated Paraphrasing Framework
abstract: arXiv:2505.03563v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are highly sensitive to subtle changes in prompt phrasing, posing challenges for reliable auditing. Prior methods often apply unconstrained prompt paraphrasing, which risk missing linguistic and demographic factors that shape authentic user interactions. We introduce AUGMENT (Automated User-Grounded Modeling and Evaluation of Natural Language Transformations), a framework for generating controlled paraphrases, grounded in user behaviors. AUGMENT leverages linguistically informed rules and enforces quality through checks on instruction adherence, semantic similarity, and realism, ensuring paraphrases are both reliable and meaningful for auditing. Through case studies on the BBQ and MMLU datasets, we show that controlled paraphrases uncover systematic weaknesses that remain obscured under unconstrained variation. These results highlight the value of the AUGMENT framework for reliable auditing.

translated_title: 换个说法：基于用户行为的自动改写框架用于大语言模型审计
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLMs）对提示词措辞的细微变化高度敏感，这给可靠的模型审计带来了挑战。先前的方法通常采用无约束的提示词改写，这可能会遗漏塑造真实用户交互的语言和人口统计因素。我们提出了AUGMENT（Automated User-Grounded Modeling and Evaluation of Natural Language Transformations，基于用户行为的自然语言转换自动建模与评估），一个以用户行为为基础生成受控改写文本的框架。AUGMENT利用基于语言学知识的规则，并通过指令遵循、语义相似性和真实性检查来保证质量，确保改写结果既可靠又有意义，适用于审计任务。通过对BBQ和MMLU数据集的案例研究，我们展示了受控改写能够揭示在无约束变化下仍然被掩盖的系统性弱点。这些结果凸显了AUGMENT框架在实现可靠审计方面的价值。
tldr: 该论文提出AUGMENT框架，通过基于用户行为的受控提示词改写来审计大语言模型，能够揭示无约束改写方式下被掩盖的系统性弱点。
en_tdlr: AUGMENT is a user-grounded controlled paraphrasing framework that enables reliable LLM auditing by uncovering systematic weaknesses that remain hidden under unconstrained paraphrasing.
